responsibility: Declares the deferred range- and type-checking subsystem used after gm2 has enough declaration information to materialize checks. It provides constructors for many kinds of pending checks—assignments, returns, subranges, array subscripts, INC/DEC, set operations, shifts/rotates, parameter bounds, for-loop bounds, pointer nil checks, missing RETURN/ELSE checks, CASE bounds, and division/modulus guards—plus routines to fold or emit those checks as GCC trees, compare tree bounds, and build runtime handler calls at source locations.
same_name_distinction: This `.def` file declares the deferred range/type-checking API and its many check-construction and emission routines; the same-name `.mod` file implements the stored check records, type/bounds reasoning, tree generation, and runtime-handler calls.
